figures.finding: Montenegrin directors have a professional body, the Association of Film Producers and Directors of Montenegro (Udruženje filmskih producenata i reditelja Crne Gore, Podgorica), listed in the Film Centre of Montenegro's directory. No directors' collective agreement, minimum fee, guaranteed period or cut right was found.
